message.content:
If you want **free online auto repair estimates**, these tools are the most directly relevant options: **RepairPal**, **Kelley Blue Book (KBB)**, **YourMechanic**, **NAPA Auto Care**, **Maaco** for body/paint work, and **Otto** for photo-based body damage estimates.[1][2][3][4][6][8]

- **RepairPal**: free estimate by entering your zip code and vehicle details; it shows fair pricing based on parts, labor, and location.[3]
- **KBB Auto Repair Pricing**: free estimator for common repairs and maintenance, with a “Fair Repair Range” based on what others have paid in your area.[6]
- **YourMechanic**: free instant estimates with a parts-and-labor breakdown, and you can book mobile service afterward.[1]
- **NAPA Auto Care**: free estimator for common repairs and routine maintenance; the site notes the result is only an estimate and you’ll need an inspection for an exact quote.[4]
- **Maaco**: free online estimate for **auto body repair, painting, and collision repair**.[8]
- **Otto**: free AI-based body repair estimate from a photo, useful for dents, scratches, and collision damage.[2]

If you want the **fastest general-purpose option**, start with **RepairPal** or **KBB** for mechanical repairs, and **Otto** or **Maaco** for body damage and paint work.[2][3][6][8]

If you want, I can also narrow this down to:
- **mechanical repairs**
- **body/paint repairs**
- **best options for your car make/model**
- **estimates that don’t require signing up**
